thread:
anne: Quick brain dump from today's sync — exploring a "heap"-style admission heuristic for routing policy to improve fairness during multi-tenant spikes. want brief sanity checks.

anne: motivation: mixed-tier spikes currently cause unpredictable tail latency. slot/token combos help but we keep seeing oscillation when many tenants compete. thought: treat per-node admission as a bounded heap of in-flight requests weighted by a stable eviction score.

sahil: eviction_score = f(tenant_credit, est_cost, tier_priority, warmup_penalty, region_bias). maintain a min-heap of active requests where the smallest score is the candidate to evict when node is saturated. avoids global coordination for short bursts.

maria: love the simplicity. questions: how to keep scores stable and explainable? recomputing on every update could be expensive.

kevin: compute score delta locally using epoch-published weights. routers keep per-tenant micro-counters (recent_success_rate, tokens_used, warmup_tokens). score = combination using those counters + epoch weights. only recompute on request start/finish. O(1) ops.

lia: runtime boundary: heap ops must be lock-free-ish. prefer sharded heaps per core or per-group to avoid contention. eviction should be cooperative: request handler checks if it's on eviction candidate list and gracefully fail.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: policy-service v0.92 pushed to staging/us-east-1 at 2026-03-25T11:02Z.

anne: tie-breaking: deterministic comparator: (eviction_score, tenant_priority, request_start_ts, tiny_jitter). small jitter to avoid pathological simultaneous evictions.

sahil: need simulation with cache-warmup model: evicting a KV-heavy request has a warmup_penalty. include warmup_penalty in score so eviction avoids cold-cache storms.

maria: explainability: expose last N contributing factors for evicted requests via explain endpoint (tokens_left, score_components, epoch_version). TTL 10m. scrub any PII.

kevin: rollout plan: 1) implement sharded heap proto in router; 2) policy-service publish epoch weights + quotas; 3) run sim with 30 days traces + synthetic multi-region bursts; 4) small canary (non-production tenants).

lia: metric hooks: per-tenant p95, eviction_rate, warmup_penalty_tokens, heap_stability (swap/sec). add alert when heap_stability > threshold.

anne: actions: @sahil - prototype heap scoring lib; @maria - sim scenarios + metrics; @kevin - explain payload and epoch API; @lia - operational limits and shard guidance. will draft short RFC after proto.

anne: leaving thread open for comments. drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
